title.narrative: Unlocking the power of data and evidence to deliver better outcomes for children on the move

description.narrative: Through this 36 month action the International Data Alliance for Children on the Move (IDAC) will drive global efforts to find solutions to the troubling gaps in child-specific data collection, analysis, sharing and use in migration and displacement context. Established in March 2020, the IDAC recognizes the imperative to bring together all concerned stakeholders globally to address the pervasive data gaps that render migrant and displaced children invisible to policy and decision makers.
